title: Blunt Double-Point Mine Pick
description: One original complete fixed blunt double-point mine-pick display: a single continuous metal-style head curves into two opposite narrowing finite blunt ends around a real central handle eye; one complete lightly bowed tapered wooden shaft passes through that eye and widens into its integral grip. The head and handle rest in a fixed lying pose. Newly authored whole geometry, not the old broad fire-axe bit or farm hoe/gooseneck rescaled, nor a separately counted extracted head. The assembled handle occupies the eye; no fully clear installed bore is claimed. Static game-art only, no practical cutting or extraction performance, use instructions, sharp-edge specification, strength, manufacture or safety guarantee.
